title: IED Browser, verified controls and improved multi-IED monitoring
titleId: IED Browser, kontrol terverifikasi, dan monitoring multi-IED
summary: Operator-accepted Windows stable application release: browse Reports, DataSets, Data Model, Files, Setting Groups and GOOSE; monitor IED values with quality and timestamps; verify model-backed Write/readback and tested SBO Enhanced actions. Installer and portable packages are the same tested public v1.6.42 binaries. Stable is a software release channel, not IEC 61850 conformance certification or proof of lossless SOE.
summaryId: Rilis aplikasi Windows stabil yang telah diterima operator: jelajahi Reports, DataSets, Data Model, Files, Setting Groups, dan GOOSE; pantau nilai IED beserta quality dan timestamp; lakukan Write/readback berbasis model dan operasi SBO Enhanced yang diuji. Installer dan portable adalah binary publik v1.6.42 yang sama dengan hasil pengujian. Status stable adalah kanal rilis software, bukan sertifikasi IEC 61850 atau bukti SOE lossless.
highlights: IED Browser navigation: Reports, DataSets, Data Model, Files, Setting Groups and GOOSE, with retained per-IED context and precise name/IP focus.
Report-first multi-IED monitoring with static DataSet membership, live values, quality, timestamps, RCB ingress and bounded user-interface updates.
Verified typed ctlModel Write/readback, focused CSWI reinspection and association-scoped, fail-closed SBO Enhanced command handling on tested targets.
SV/SMV waveform viewer with passive first-received discovery without SCL; GOOSE timeline, SNTP IPv4 presentation and modern cool-blue Windows interface.
Native COMTRADE analysis through the pinned ArdIrec bridge, with source-verified installer and portable delivery.
highlightsId: IED Browser: Reports, DataSets, Data Model, Files, Setting Groups, dan GOOSE; konteks tiap IED tetap tersimpan, nama/IP perangkat jelas.
Monitoring multi-IED berbasis report: anggota DataSet statis, nilai live, quality, timestamp, ingress RCB, dan refresh antarmuka yang terkontrol.
Write/readback ctlModel bertipe dan terverifikasi, CSWI diperiksa ulang sesudah Write, serta kontrol SBO Enhanced yang dibatasi association dan aman saat verifikasi gagal.
Viewer gelombang SV/SMV dengan deteksi paket pertama tanpa SCL; timeline GOOSE, tampilan IPv4 SNTP, dan antarmuka Windows cool-blue.
Analisis COMTRADE native melalui ArdIrec yang dipin, didistribusikan dengan installer dan portable terverifikasi.
improvements: Release workflow #40151975055 passed with 2,987/2,987 application tests, Windows installer and portable smoke tests, SHA-256, SPDX 2.3 SBOM, provenance and attestations.

Observed operator diagnostic: 5/5 monitoring endpoints, 183/183 initial selected values, 14/14 static RCB paths with ingress; successful targeted SG7_BCU and GR_X_7SX85 ctlModel readback and SBO Enhanced operations.
Download links target the latest stable GitHub Release assets; checksum values and source identity correspond to the exact tagged v1.6.42 binaries.

Eight actual ARSAS v1.6.42 Windows screenshots, supplied by the operator, are available as original full-resolution PNG and optimized WebP across the site. Images demonstrate UI only, not physical R7/R10 certification.
improvementsId: Workflow release #40151975055 sukses: 2.987/2.987 tes aplikasi, smoke test installer dan portable Windows, SHA-256, SPDX 2.3 SBOM, provenance, serta attestation.

Diagnostik operator: 5/5 endpoint monitoring, 183/183 nilai awal, 14/14 jalur RCB statis menerima report; Write/readback ctlModel dan SBO Enhanced berhasil pada target SG7_BCU serta GR_X_7SX85 yang diuji.
Link unduhan mengarah ke aset GitHub Latest Stable; checksum dan identitas source sesuai binary v1.6.42 bertag.
Delapan screenshot asli ARSAS v1.6.42 dari operator tersedia sebagai PNG resolusi penuh dan WebP optimal di website. Gambar hanya menunjukkan UI, bukan sertifikasi fisik R7/R10.
knownLimitations: The October 25 operator capture observed 432 report frames, 38 continuity findings and 9 IED-reported BufOvfl notices. These are not 38 proven lost events, but lossless buffered SOE is NOT established.

Physical R7/R10 authority, buffered replay/EntryID and reconnect verification, SCL/IID parity, SV on-wire parity and broader device acceptance remain incomplete. Some monitored endpoints may be same-host simulators.
The ARIEC61850 engine is pinned to a code-trial revision (PR #192); application stable release does not certify this engine or universal IEC 61850 interoperability.
Windows x64 only. Installer and portable executables are not commercially Authenticode-signed; verify their SHA-256 and follow Windows security policy.
Raw-Ethernet GOOSE/SV capture requires approved Npcap, suitable network visibility and permissions. Active IED control must follow an authorized safe test procedure.
knownLimitationsId: Capture operator 25 Oktober mencatat 432 frame report, 38 temuan kontinuitas, dan 9 indikasi BufOvfl dari IED. Itu bukan bukti 38 event hilang, tetapi SOE buffered lossless BELUM dibuktikan.
Kualifikasi fisik R7/R10, replay/EntryID dan reconnect, paritas SCL/IID, SV on-wire, serta penerimaan lintas perangkat belum lengkap. Sebagian endpoint mungkin simulator lokal.
Engine ARIEC61850 tetap pada revisi code-trial (PR #192); stable aplikasi bukan sertifikasi engine atau jaminan interoperabilitas IEC 61850 universal.
Hanya Windows x64. Installer dan portable belum ditandatangani Authenticode komersial; periksa SHA-256 dan ikuti kebijakan keamanan Windows.
Capture raw-Ethernet GOOSE/SV membutuhkan Npcap yang disetujui, visibility jaringan, dan permission sesuai. Kontrol IED aktif wajib melalui prosedur pengujian yang sah dan aman.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
